notes: Governmental funds are modified cash basis (fund balance equals cash, CDs, investments and county treasurer cash, no liabilities); business-type funds (Water, Sewer) are accrual, so business_type uses net position. basis set to cash because the governmental funds roll forward on cash. beginning_cash = Total Governmental Funds fund balance 9/30/2024 (p6, equal to cash and investments since no liabilities); ending_cash = total assets of governmental funds (p4), which includes certificates of deposit, investments 97,407 and county treasurer cash. Governmental receipts/disbursements use the Total Governmental Funds column (p6, right half of the statement). No transfers at the total level; the 186,000 General Fund to Ambulance department transfer is internal to the General Fund (net 0) and is recorded in detail only. Business-type: no single total printed; receipts = total operating revenues 312,545 (no nonoperating revenues), disbursements = operating expenses 325,514 + nonoperating 11,393 = 336,907; 1,162,002 + 312,545 - 336,907 = 1,137,640. Balance sheet = government-wide Statement of Net Position, Total column (p1; governmental part is modified cash basis). Proprietary cash flow figures are from the total column of p9 (capital 'purchase of capital assets' etc. net -63,570; investing = increase in restricted cash -43,768; no noncapital financing). Detail: General Fund recorded from the General Fund Departments combining schedule (pp15-16, department columns) which supersedes the General Fund budget schedule (p10) - not double counted; p10 was not recorded so budget_final is null for General Fund lines. Street, Debt Service and Sales Tax budget schedules recorded with the 'Budget (Original)' column as budget_final (no separate final budget printed). Nonmajor funds Youth Projects, CDA, CDBG from p14. 'Salaries, taxes, and benefits' mapped to salaries and wages (mixed with benefits). Garbage department categorised as utilities while the statement puts it under Public works. Attempt 2 (charges-for-services re-check): statement 'Charges for services' 174,487 (p6, all General Fund) split by the department columns of pp15-16 (General 19,206 charges for services; Ambulance 33,139 Ambulance Fees; Pool 11,601 and Horse Arena 335 Recreation Fees; Garbage 110,206 Utility Charges), with the same categories on the detail lines; business-type 'Sales' 303,284 (Water 179,834 + Sewer 123,450) moved to Utility Charges. Totals unchanged. Read pages 1-16 of 16.
